bots.name: Amzn-User
bots.description: Amazon's on-demand fetcher supporting user actions, such as responding to Alexa queries that need up-to-date information; Amazon states it does not crawl content for generative AI model training. Amazon publishes a human-readable live-crawl IP list but no machine-parseable feed.

bots.name: ChatGPT-User
bots.description: OpenAI's user-triggered fetcher, used when a ChatGPT user or a GPT Action asks the assistant to visit a specific page. It does not crawl autonomously.

instances: Mozilla/5.0 AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko); compatible; ChatGPT-User/1.0; +https://openai.com/bot

bots.name: Claude-User
bots.description: Anthropic's user-triggered fetcher, used when a person asks Claude to visit a specific web page (e.g. via tool use in a conversation).

bots.name: DuckAssistBot
bots.description: DuckDuckGo's real-time fetcher for DuckDuckGo Search's AI-assisted answers, which cite their sources. DuckDuckGo states the data is not used to train AI models, and publishes a machine-readable list of the bot's IP addresses.

bots.name: Google-Agent
bots.description: The fetcher used by AI agents hosted on Google infrastructure to navigate the web and perform actions on behalf of a user who asked for them. Google publishes a dedicated IP range list for it and signs a subset of its requests with Web Bot Auth under the agent.bot.goog identity. As a user-triggered fetcher it generally ignores robots.txt rules.

bots.name: Google user-triggered fetchers
bots.description: Google tools and product features that fetch a specific page because an end user asked for it (Google Read Aloud, Site Verifier, Gemini Notebook, Chrome Web Store, Google Messages, Pinpoint, Publisher Center, and similar), rather than autonomous crawling for search indexing. They generally ignore robots.txt because a human requested the fetch.

bots.name: Meta External Fetcher
bots.description: Meta's on-demand fetcher that retrieves a single link at a user's request to support agentic AI features (e.g. an AI assistant navigating a page a user asked about), rather than broad indexing. Verified by ASN lookup (AS32934).

bots.name: MistralAI-User
